summary: When availability matters, keep logging on failure: overwrite the oldest records if storage is full, and queue locally while the central server is unreachable. Set `LOG_AGGREGATOR_ACTION_MAX_DISK_USAGE_GB` to your buffer size and `LOG_AGGREGATOR_MAX_DISK_USAGE_PATH` to `/var/lib/awx` via a PUT to `/api/v2/settings/logging/` as a controller admin.
questions: How do I make controller buffer logs when the aggregator is down?
Configure controller logging settings through the API

answer_card.title: Buffer logs locally via the API
answer_card.answer_md:
As a controller admin, browse to `/api/v2/settings/logging/` and PUT:
```json
{
  "LOG_AGGREGATOR_ACTION_MAX_DISK_USAGE_GB": <org buffer size>,
  "LOG_AGGREGATOR_MAX_DISK_USAGE_PATH": "/var/lib/awx"
}
```
Logs then queue on disk while the aggregator is unreachable.
